$description: The ratchet (crew#7019): every path and the number of violations it may still have. The guard refuses a path only when it is above its number, so today's measurements start green and a surface that reaches zero turns its entry into a refusal. Entries are a partition: a nested entry owns its own files, so each scope's number is its own. The numbers are the counts measured on main today (2026-10-24, main b55225844) and the guard judges a branch against the base it measures on origin/main, so a lane is never red for main's own violations; see guards/purity.mjs for the three rules (cap, teeth, fresh).
